findings.correction: One async observation importer precedes receiving dispatch/checks and applies failure limits. Identity deduplication, evidence/scope/cancellation guards remain. Scope is rechecked after awaited host progress code.

Internal WeakMap correlates original admitted effect/outcome with authentic delivery before observers, surviving re-registration and optional outcome omission. Legacy fallback never consults mutable registration.
Formatting a stopped tool or empty/synthetic response appends a separate answer, preserving connected exact calls/results and protected raw data.
Shared internal stop finalization commits already-journalled settled input without another model response or journal duplication, before stream completion events.
Explicitly capture validated callbacks and bind original host receiver; snapshot thresholds/read allowlists without dropping prototype/private-state policies.

redRegression.explanation: Ten permanent regressions written before production fixes: nine failed, explicit-continuation R1 control passed. All five findings reproduced.

iterationNotes: Six original assertions expected settled input to remain pending; updated to verify committed history after the new normal stop boundary. Early-close retention assertion remains unchanged.

Expanded test harness corrections: one syntax/type setup error, private result/outcome capture for host repair, conservative legacy state field, and cancellation retention vs scope clearing. These were test setup corrections, not disabled assertions.
First mixed sandboxed focused batch had an existing local HTTP fixture EPERM; final full unit run used authorized fixture-server access and has zero failures/skips.
First correction live batch 134/135: Google schema-valid empty summary rejected before main dispatch. All 18 Stage 10 cases passed. Final unchanged all-provider batch 135/135.

limitations: Host callbacks remain cooperative authorized reads; local validation cannot prove semantic truth or preempt synchronous blocked JavaScript.
Invocation correlation is process-local and is not restored authority. Unknown uncorrelated legacy action observations block conservatively.
Fresh executions have fresh counters; no durable/semantic exactly-once guarantee. Storage or state recovery never authorizes external action replay.

Configured stream still uses its existing blocking-tool ownership boundary; pending queued async observations require existing explicit continuation/run delivery. Direct/external/realtime/native internal loops remain outside this policy.
Stream text remains provisional; final JSON repair stays run-only and subject to existing fit/model-task budgets.
Live probes are bounded functional checks. The retained Google helper failure precludes general deterministic model-adherence/reliability claims.
Stage 12 and conditional Stage 11 remain separately authorized, unimplemented; no package release.
